hook: George Kurtz founded CrowdStrike and has led it as president and chief executive since January 2012, building the company around Falcon, an endpoint security platform delivered from the cloud. Before that he worked at Price Waterhouse and Ernst and Young, started Foundstone, which McAfee bought in 2004, and served as McAfee's worldwide chief technology officer. He is a co-author of the book Hacking Exposed.

quick_facts: President, CEO and founder of CrowdStrike since January 2012, according to his LinkedIn profile

Spent November 2011 to January 2012 as Executive in Residence at Warburg Pincus, where his profile says he assembled CrowdStrike's founding team, wrote the original business plan and raised its Series A
Founded Foundstone in 1999 and led it as CEO until McAfee acquired it in October 2004, for nearly 90 million dollars by his profile's account
Worldwide chief technology officer and executive vice president of McAfee from October 2009 to October 2011
Holds a BS in accounting from Seton Hall University and the CISSP, CISA and CPA credentials
Co-author of Hacking Exposed: Network Security Secrets and Solutions
